type.description: The type id of the request

servers.description: The number of servers in the cluster, the length of server_names when left out

snippets.description: Config snippets keyed by the main template extension point they fill

template.description: A custom main config template, the built-in one when empty

mode.description: The TLS verification mode, server for one-way TLS or mutual to require a client cert, mutual when empty

sans.description: Subject Alternative Names for the server cert, IPs as IP SANs and other values as DNS names, localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 when empty

handshake_first.description: Performs the TLS handshake before the server sends INFO, clients must dial handshake first

timeout.description: The TLS handshake timeout in seconds, fractions honored, 2 seconds when zero

tls.description: Generated TLS on the client ports, none when absent

cluster_name.description: The cluster's name, a letter then letters, digits, _ or -, at most 28 characters, the default name when left out

server_names.description: The servers' names in order, each a letter then letters, digits, _ or -, at most 32 characters

trace.description: Fronts every node with a capture proxy that stores every connection's trace, implies proxy

proxy.description: Fronts every node with a capture proxy that stores no captures

toxics.description: Sends every route and every node's clients through agent proxies so toxics can act on them

wait_jetstream.description: How long in seconds the create waits, once its servers are ready, for every server to report JetStream enabled under one meta leader with every peer current, fractions honored, no wait when zero

system_credentials.description: How the JetStream wait authenticates to the system account, the built-in template's system user when absent
